hypothesis: A compact factorized causal memory policy trained from selected rewards can outperform a fully trained recurrent GRU16, a memoryless MLP, and fixed calibration/reward-only controls when actuator state persists and shift timing is unfamiliar.
null: No 5% gain over strongest eligible trained or fixed nonoracle control on both seeds after complete source custody; preserve null.

source.law: Fresh worlds use original R70 physical actuator transition law: selected CALIBRATE0 costs −0.35, emits noisy actual causal sign and sets persistent actuator alignment h to hidden causal sign; SHAM1 costs same with no physical repair; chosen exploit2/3 rewards depend on h and law with .70 noise. The learner sees only selected action observation and public timestep; never h, hidden sign, stage, future/counterfactual.
source.shift_times: For half worlds hidden B starts uniformly at t9..18 and A returns t22..35, wider than R70. Other half stable. Within stable/switched each initial sign balanced.
source.proxy: Irrelevant unobserved nuisance proxy perturbed independently for negative control.
source.admission: Fresh FIT and CAL and DEV each independently seeded, never reuse any R70 DEV. FIT only for policy-gradient optimization, CAL read-only and DEV once after ALL seeds/arms trained.

arms.candidate: STRUCTURED_CAUSAL_MEMORY: learned softmax among physical CALIBRATE0, exploit2, exploit3 based on public time, last observed selected reward, previous factual calibration sign and reward-based sign error EMA, time-since-last-factual-calibration; allocated 16 float fast state and small 8->3 trainable logit head; update fast state AFTER selected action and outcome.
arms.GRU16: Fully trained conventional GRUCell hidden16; input last actual selected action one-hot4, last observed consequence4, public scaled time1; head 16->3 logits for same actions. Train with same FIT episodes/steps.
arms.MLP16: Fully trained conventional memoryless one-hidden-layer MLP9->16 tanh->3 on same last selected action/consequence and public time; same FIT episodes/steps, no recurrence.
arms.fixed_R70: On fresh R71 worlds run original R70 CALIBRATE_CAUSAL t0,16,32; R70_BLIND_CALIBRATE_REACTIVE; R70_NO_CALIBRATE_REACTIVE; evaluator-only ORACLE_DYNAMIC_PRIVILEGED. Never tune fixed controls on DEV.

training.selection_seed_formula: 24319999 + seed; same sampled FIT world index batch per optimizer step in all three learned arms
training.action_sampling_seed_formula: seed + fixed arm-specific offset; Torch CPU categorical softmax; same realized action transition protocol, no counterfactual exposures
training.objective: REINFORCE policy gradient on selected 40-step episode reward-to-go with batch-per-time-step mean baseline and fixed scaling 8.0, entropy bonus 0.005; no private law/action teacher or future outcome feature; each optimizer step uses exactly 8 FIT episodes and 320 selected action consequences per arm.
training.evaluation: All trainable models/seeds must complete training BEFORE CAL/DEV outputs constructed. Evaluation greedy deterministic; no CAL/DEV tuning or optimizer update.

metrics.primary: Mean net actual selected goal reward across 40 actions on independently sampled DEV96.
metrics.secondary: Switched DEV actual return-phase selected reward t36..39, stable-world full reward, real calibration action count, physical alignment and negative controls.
metrics.strongest: Highest DEV mean selected episode reward among all trained and fixed eligible comparators (excluding private oracle)
metrics.admission_on_success: DEV_TRAINED_POLICY_SIGNAL_ONLY; not full native Hybrid general intelligence or independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS
metrics.admission_on_failure: DEV_NO_GO; preserve original negative, no post-score adjustment
